question: Which of our permits expire in the next 12 months?
answer:
Only one permit on file expires in the next 12 months: the **Standard Air Contaminant Discharge Permit No. 26-2841-ST-01 — Portland Facility**. It expires **November 15, 2026**, which is 12 days from today (November 3, 2026).

**Renewal is the urgent part.** That permit's condition 1.3 set the renewal application deadline at July 18, 2026, and that date has passed. Nothing in your documents shows a renewal application or a DEQ receipt. The permit's condition 1.2 says you must not operate after expiry unless the permit is renewed or a timely renewal application was filed. I can't tell from your documents whether you filed. Did you? If you did, add the application and DEQ's receipt to your file. If you didn't, contact DEQ's Northwest Region office now.

Your documents show no other permits, licenses or registrations. Other certificates may exist that aren't in your list, so tell me if there are any.

**Other dates to know:**
- The **Certificate of Annual Maintenance, Portable Fire Extinguishers (14 units)** is dated August 20, 2025. It's marked current, but it sets no expiry date. Annual service would point to around August 2026. I haven't confirmed that, and no newer certificate is on file.
- The permit's semi-annual report for January to June 2026 was due July 31, 2026. Only the **Annual Report, Reporting Year 2025** is on file, so I can't see this one.
- The permit's quarterly scrubber inspection was due by September 30, 2026. The **Scrubber Pressure-Drop Log** doesn't show one.
- The next annual report is due February 15, 2027.

If you'd like, I can draft a checklist of what to gather to prove the permit renewal was filed on time.
